effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

changes.historical_text: When this monster destroys the following number of monsters as a result of battle, the following effects are activated in order:One: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them.Two: You can Special Summon 1 "Fushioh Richie" from your hand or your Deck by Tributing this card during your Main Phase.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.spop finds no "Fushioh Richie" in hand or Deck it reveals both zones to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is identical between the baseline version and the modern one.

changes.historical_text: When this monster destroys the following number of monsters as a result of battle, the following effects are activated in order:One: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them.Two: You can Special Summon 1 "Fushioh Richie" from your hand or your Deck by Tributing this card during your Main Phase.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.sptg keeps only the free-zone test (ft>0) and drops the modern script's Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_HAND,...), so the Ignition effect can be activated - and Great Dezard itself Tributed as cost - with no "Fushioh Richie" to Special Summon. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Pure ruling record: the baseline text matches lineage v1 (DB2-EN220, Dark Beginning 2, 2005-07-27) exactly AND v1 is also the modern text (modern_text_matches_version = v1, exact), so there is no text transition to record at all - hence modern_text_version null on both changes. v1's printing postdates the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot, where v0 (PGD-020, 2003-07-18) was in force, but v0 -> v1 is the standard Magic->Spell, "specifically designate ... as a target"->"target", "offering ... as a Tribute"->"Tributing" pass and is cosmetic. Remaining script diffs are refactors with no behavioural consequence: the GOAT copy hand-rolls the Tribute cost as s.spcost (IsReleasable / Duel.Release(REASON_COST)) where modern calls the Cost.SelfTribute helper, and it hand-registers the "Double Snare" validity marker as effect e4 (SetCode(3682106), CANNOT_DISABLE+UNCOPYABLE+SINGLE_RANGE, range MZONE, condition s.effcon) where modern calls aux.DoubleSnareValidity(c,LOCATION_MZONE) - the same registration; plus RESET_EVENT|RESETS_STANDARD written with +. The negation half of the card (e1/e2 flag-effect counting and the QUICK_F negate-and-destroy) is byte-equivalent. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
